name: STP — Effluent Quality Standard (BOD/COD/TSS/pH/O&G)
description: Treated effluent must meet prescribed discharge/reuse standards before release or reuse

name: Site — Flow Meter Calibration
description: Effluent/water flow meters must be calibrated and log maintained

name: Organization — Consent to Operate (Water)
description: Valid CTO must be held and renewed before expiry for water-related discharge

name: Site — Water Cess Return (Water Cess Act 1977)
description: Self-assessed water consumption cess return, where applicable

name: DG Set — Stack Emission Limit (PM/SO2/NOx/CO)
description: Stack emissions from DG sets must remain within CPCB/SPCB notified limits

name: Boiler — Stack Emission Limit
description: Boiler stack emissions must remain within prescribed limits

name: Site — Ambient Air Quality Standard (NAAQS)
description: Ambient air quality at site boundary must meet National Ambient Air Quality Standards

name: DG Set — Stack Height Compliance
description: DG set stack height must meet CPCB norm relative to DG capacity/building height

name: Organization — Consent to Operate (Air)
description: Valid CTO must be held and renewed for air-emission sources

name: Site — Environmental Statement (Form V)
description: Annual environmental statement summarizing water/air/waste performance must be filed

name: Site — CGWA Groundwater Extraction NOC
description: Bore-well water extraction requires CGWA No-Objection Certificate and periodic reporting

name: Hazardous Waste Yard — Storage Duration Limit (<=90 days)
description: Hazardous waste must not be stored beyond the permitted duration without SPCB extension

name: DG Set / Vendor — Used Oil Manifest
description: Used oil from DG sets must be handed over to an authorized recycler with a manifest

name: Hazardous Waste Yard — Segregation & Labelling
description: Hazardous waste must be segregated by category and labelled per Schedule III

name: Organization — Hazardous Waste Authorization
description: Valid Rule 6 authorization must be held and renewed

name: Site — Source Segregation (Wet/Dry/Hazardous)
description: Solid waste must be segregated at source into wet, dry and domestic-hazardous streams

name: Organization — Bulk Generator Registration
description: Registration as a bulk waste generator with the local body, with a waste management plan on file

name: Site — Wet Waste Processing Record
description: On-site wet waste processing (composting/biogas) volumes must be logged where mandated

name: Site — Ambient Noise Limit (day/night, zone-specific)
description: Boundary noise levels must remain within notified day/night limits for the applicable zone

name: DG Set — Acoustic Enclosure Integrity
description: DG sets must be housed in acoustic enclosures maintained to manufacturer/CPCB spec

name: Organization — Single-Use Plastic (SUP) Prohibition
description: Identified single-use plastic items (notified list) must not be used or distributed on-site

name: Organization — EPR Registration & Annual Return
description: Plastic packaging use must be registered on the CPCB EPR portal with an annual return

name: IT/Electronic Asset — E-Waste Disposal Manifest
description: End-of-life electronics must be handed to an authorized dismantler/recycler with a manifest

name: DG Set / UPS Battery — Battery Take-Back Manifest
description: Used lead-acid/other batteries must be returned to an authorized collection agency

name: Bio-Medical Waste Store — Colour-Coded Segregation (Schedule I)
description: Bio-medical waste must be segregated into colour-coded bags/containers per category

name: Bio-Medical Waste Store — CBWTF Handover Manifest (barcoded)
description: Waste must be handed to the Common Bio-medical Waste Treatment Facility with a barcoded manifest

name: Autoclave/Deep Burial Pit (if on-site) — Treatment Efficacy Standard
description: On-site autoclaving, where used, must meet validated time/temperature/pressure parameters

name: Organization — Bio-Medical Waste Authorization
description: Valid Rule 10 authorization must be held and renewed

name: Site (during renovation) — C&D Waste Management Plan
description: A waste management plan must be filed and executed for renovation/demolition activity
